name: Roberta Perlman
office: Pomona Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 4

items.text: Dr. Roberta Perlman is Vice President of the Pomona Unified School District Board of Education. She has served on the board since 2009. She is an optometrist and an assistant professor at Western University of Health Sciences.

sentences.text: Dr. Roberta Perlman is Vice President of the Pomona Unified School District Board of Education.
She has served on the board since 2009.
She is an optometrist and an assistant professor at Western University of Health Sciences.

items.text: Her campaign website says the district has a 92% graduation rate, over 50 new transitional kindergarten classrooms, and three dual language immersion programs. She supports expanding preschool, career technical education, and arts and music programs. In a 2026 candidate questionnaire, she said the district is considering building workforce housing to attract and retain educators.
